records.name: Canonical runtime and presence
records.productClaim: One RuntimeHost owns startup, shutdown, presence, recovery, and resource composition.

records.name: Conversational cognition
records.authorityRequirement: none for cognition; actions require authority
records.productClaim: Bounded context and capability evidence inform normal cognition; this does not claim all world state is current.

records.name: Governed consequential action
records.productClaim: Consequential operations use one fail-closed authority/action/verification path.

records.name: Memory and experience
records.productClaim: Memory and experience provide evidence and learning signals, not authority.

records.name: Bounded awareness bridge
records.productClaim: Headless Sensorium/Mata Dewa observations can reach World Model and bounded Context projection; no continuous visual awareness claim.

records.name: Messaging and voice ingress
records.authorityRequirement: channel identity plus canonical action path
records.productClaim: Telegram, WhatsApp, and voice are alternate surfaces over one Damar identity; configuration/authentication remain environment-dependent.

records.name: Companion and mesh devices
records.authorityRequirement: device identity/pairing plus canonical action path
records.productClaim: Pairing and mesh trust code exist; no single unified device trust read model is claimed.

records.name: Tools, plugins, and extensions
records.productClaim: Installed tools/plugins are not automatically governed capabilities or authority.

records.name: Skills and workflows
records.productClaim: Five JSON skill definitions and the skill engine exist; skill presence is not certification or authority.

records.name: Model/provider access
records.authorityRequirement: none for inference; actions still require authority
records.productClaim: OpenRouter, federation, Mata Dewa provider paths, and the source-backed local llama.cpp provider/configuration path exist; no W1 multi-instance gateway, provider-management UI, health/fallback routing surface, or universal model coverage is claimed.

records.name: DCD security observation
records.productClaim: Detection, scoring, simulation, and proposals remain separate from authorization and execution.

records.name: Control APIs and read models
records.authorityRequirement: API auth plus Manager/Authority for mutations
records.productClaim: HTTP/API and MCP boundaries exist; the terminal WebSocket code boundary exists but is currently disabled before attachment with HTTP 503, while the retired Console is not restored and no production Dashboard UI exists.

records.name: L11 synthesis catalog
records.productClaim: Twelve records and eight designs are retained as design evidence, not implemented features.

records.name: Idle/Presence visual experience
records.productClaim: Primary product direction only; no W1 production UI is claimed.
